summary: (A 100% wholly owned subsidiary of Apraava Energy Private Limited), Through its Authorized Representative, T-15 A, Third Floor, Salcon Rasvilas, Saket, New Delhi - 110017. **Petitioner** 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition for approval for the creation and perfection of a Security Interest in terms of the Financing Document through the mortgage, hypothecation, charge, or assignment over rights, title, interest, claims, demands, benefits under, clearance, project documents, agreements, and approvals of the Petitioner in favour of the Axis Trustee Services Limited (Respondent No. 2). The Petitioner has also requested for the approval of documents that create security as well as other documents pertaining to the term loan facility. The Petitioner has made the following prayers: - _b. approve the creation of the security interest by the Petitioner over the Hypothecated Properties to the extent described in this Petition for the benefit of the Lender and for its successors, subsequent transferees, novatees, assigns and any refinancing lenders to the Project by way of hypothecation/ assignment/ mortgage (if any);_ - _c. approve and allow the execution of the Unattested Deed of Hypothecation for Hypothecation for creation and perfection of the security interest to the extent described in this Petition in favour of the Respondent No. 2 i.e., Axis Trustee Services Limited;_ - _e. pass any such order(s), further relief(s) in the facts and circumstances of the case as this Commission may deem just and equitable in favour of the Petitioner.”_ 3. The Petitioner, RIVPTL, is a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013. Respondent no. 2 i.e., Axis Trustee Services Limited (hereinafter referred to as the “Security Trustee”), who is acting as the Security Trustee for the purpose of holding the securities on behalf of and for benefit of the lender i.e., Respondent No. 3, Axis Bank Limited (hereinafter referred to as “Lender”), and any other banks or financial institutions participating in the facility, in terms of the Security Trustee Agreement dated 26.9.2025. 5. The Petitioner has further submitted that the Loan Agreement was executed in relation to the Project Facility, which has been agreed to be extended by the Lender(s) to the Borrower on and subject to the terms and conditions set out in the Loan Agreement and the other financing documents. 6. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Loan Agreement, the secured obligations are secured by: - (ii) a first ranking exclusive pledge in respect of the Pledged Securities held by the Sponsor, at all times till the Final Settlement Date; and 7. The Petitioner has submitted that in terms of the Financing Documents, the Petitioner is required to create security, which is the transaction security (as defined under the Financing Agreements), in favour of a Security Trustee for the benefit of the lender. 8. The Petitioner has stated that Article 15.2.2 of the Transmission Service Agreement entered into between the Petitioner and the beneficiaries of the project provides that the Petitioner is free to create any encumbrance over all or part of the receivables, Letter of Credit, or other assets of the project in favour of the lenders or the representative of the lenders as security for the amount payable under the Financing Agreements and any other amounts agreed by the parties. The Petitioner has submitted that, in terms of Article 15 of the TSA, the Petitioner is required to obtain permission from the Commission prior to relinquishing or transferring its rights and obligations in the TSA. 10. The Petition was called out for the hearing on 3.2.2026 after notice to the Respondents. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) for the hearing on 3.2.2026, the Respondents were granted the opportunity to file their respective replies, and the Petitioner was directed to furnish, by way of affidavit, the application of funds and sources of funds as on the date of application. 12. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the Petitioner has complied with the directions issued vide RoP dated 3.2.2026 and placed on record the compliance affidavit. He further submitted that no reply has been filed by the Respondents. Considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the matter was reserved for order. _“17. The Petitioner is directed to submit a signed copy of the Indenture of Mortgage for the Project immediately after its execution. 22. In the event of a default by the licensee regarding debt repayment, the Commission may, upon a joint application submitted by the licensee, lender, Security Trustee, and nominee, grant approval for the assignment of the licence to a nominee, contingent upon the satisfactory completion of due diligence procedures. Consequently, it is imperative to obtain explicit prior approval from the Commission for the assignment of the licence to the nominee of the Security Trustee or for the transfer of any assets to them. Finally, the Petitioner is required to submit the financial documents and statements in accordance with the Commission’s directives.
